metadata.title: Run outputs, checkpoints and code for: Terrain Helps SAR Flood Mapping on New Floods, and Same-Event Splits Hide It
metadata.description: Everything needed to check or reuse the results of the paper without retraining: (1) the code at the commit the paper's numbers come from (MIT license); (2) every run directory without weights: the resolved training config including git commit, training history, validation metrics, and per-chip confusion counts for every evaluation (Sen1Floods11 leave-one-event-out, GEOID-Flood test and held-out 2026 events, GEOID-Flood pre/post protocol), plus all report tables the paper quotes (reports/paper_20261121); (3) the checkpoints of every model behind a GEOID-Flood result: U-Net, ResNet-34 U-Net, change-detection U-Net and TerraMind-1.0-base, each with and without HAND, trained on Sen1Floods11 (11 events) or on GEOID-Flood subsets of 10-159 events. SHA-256 sums in SHA256SUMS. Input data are not redistributed; they are public (Sen1Floods11, GEOID-Flood CC BY 4.0, Copernicus GLO-30 DEM, ASF GLO-30 HAND, ESA WorldCover, JRC Global Surface Water) and the repository's REPRODUCE.md rebuilds them.
metadata.notes: Code is MIT-licensed (LICENSE inside code_*.tar.gz); run outputs and checkpoints are CC BY 4.0. Derived from GEOID-Flood labels (CC BY 4.0).
